parameters.content:
## 4. Daily scheduler
Every weekday at 07:30: sends due automatic emails, posts overdue tasks per team, and checks day-1 readiness as GREEN, AMBER or RED.

**Setup**
1. Fill **Config**. For the demo set readiness_days_ahead to the days until the test hire starts.
2. Credentials: Postgres, Gmail.
3. Use **Run now** to test, then Publish to switch on the schedule.
4. Settings > Error workflow: 6 - BrewTec error alerts.

**Health check**
Posts to #brewtec-agent-dev-ops (discord_ops_webhook) only when someone must act: approvals waiting over 2 days, repeated AI failures, many hand-offs, an empty knowledge base, or a low weekly quality score.

**Data retention**
Daily clean-up: chats after 90 days (chat_retention_days), code checks and cached answers after 30 days, logs after 1 year, sent-back hires after 180 days.

parameters.query:
-- Due automatic e-mails. The Personalfragebogen stays open until the new hire submits it:
-- a new personal single-use link is created for each mail, with a reminder every 3 days.
select t.id as task_id, t.task_key, t.title, t.link_key, t.due_date,
       e.id as employee_id, e.first_name, e.private_email,
       (t.last_sent_at is not null) as is_reminder,
       case when t.task_key = 'pfb_form' then pfb_create_link(e.id, 14) end as pfb_token
from onboarding_tasks t
join employees e on e.id = t.employee_id
where t.auto and t.completed_at is null and t.due_date <= current_date
  and e.status = 'approved' and t.task_key <> 'welcome_email'
  and (t.last_sent_at is null
       or (t.task_key = 'pfb_form' and t.last_sent_at < now() - interval '3 days'))
order by t.due_date;

-- Information mails are done once sent. The Personalfragebogen is done only when the
-- new hire submits it (workflow 11), so here only the send time is recorded.
with u as (
  update onboarding_tasks
  set last_sent_at = now(),
      completed_at = case when task_key = 'pfb_form' then completed_at else now() end,
      completed_by = case when task_key = 'pfb_form' then completed_by else 'wf4' end
  where id = $1::uuid and completed_at is null
  returning employee_id, task_key
)
insert into automation_log (employee_id, workflow, step, status, detail)
select employee_id, 'wf4', 'auto_task', 'sent', task_key from u
returning id;

select t.owner_team, count(*)::int as overdue_count,
       string_agg(format('- %s (%s %s., due %s)', t.title, e.first_name, left(e.last_name, 1),
                  to_char(t.due_date, 'DD.MM.')), E'\n' order by t.due_date) as lines
from onboarding_tasks t
join employees e on e.id = t.employee_id
where t.completed_at is null and not t.auto and t.due_date < current_date
  and e.status = 'approved'
group by t.owner_team;

select
  (select count(*) from employees where status = 'pending_approval'
     and created_at < now() - interval '2 days')::int as stale_approvals,
  (select string_agg(first_name || ' ' || left(last_name, 1) || '.', ', ') from employees
     where status = 'pending_approval' and created_at < now() - interval '2 days') as stale_names,
  (select count(*) from automation_log where workflow = 'wf3' and step = 'ai_call'
     and status = 'failed' and created_at > now() - interval '1 day')::int as ai_failures_24h,
  (select count(*) from chat_messages where handoff and created_at > now() - interval '1 day'
     and coalesce(session_id, '') not like 'qc-%')::int as handoffs_24h,
  (select count(*) from handbook_documents)::int as kb_chunks,
  (select round(100.0 * avg(passed::int)) from quality_checks
     where run_at = (select max(run_at) from quality_checks)) as last_quality_score,
  (select extract(day from now() - max(run_at))::int from quality_checks) as days_since_quality_check;

-- Deletes chats after chat_retention_days, code checks and cached answers after 30 days,
-- log and quality rows after 365 days, and sent-back or cancelled hires after 180 days.
with p as (select * from purge_expired_data($1::int))
insert into automation_log (workflow, step, status, detail)
select 'wf4', 'retention', 'ok', format('deleted %s chats, %s code checks, %s cached answers, '
       '%s log rows, %s quality rows, %s closed hires, %s old form links', chats, code_checks,
       cached_answers, logs, quality_rows, closed_hires, form_links)
from p
returning detail;
